cpu_motherboard.rule: CPU socket must match motherboard socket

memory_motherboard.rule: Memory type must match motherboard support

memory_capacity.rule: Total memory cannot exceed motherboard maximum

gpu_pcie_slots.rule: Number of GPUs cannot exceed available PCIe x16 slots

power_requirements.rule: PSU wattage must exceed total system power draw by 20%

cooling_requirements.rule: Cooling solution must handle CPU TDP

case_motherboard.rule: Case must support motherboard form factor

gpu_case_clearance.rule: GPU length must fit within case

cooler_case_clearance.rule: CPU cooler height must fit within case

pcie_bandwidth.rule: Total PCIe lanes used cannot exceed CPU provision

high_power_draw.message: System requires high wattage PSU and may need dedicated circuit

extreme_cooling.message: CPU requires high-end cooling solution, consider custom loop

memory_channels.message: Memory configuration not optimal for available channels

gpu_spacing.message: Multiple GPUs may have thermal issues without proper spacing or liquid cooling

memory_configuration.xeon_w: Use all memory channels for optimal performance (8 channels = 8 modules minimum)

gpu_configuration.compute: Match VRAM to dataset size requirements
